is001.t: Lee wants to swim at the pool on Saturday morning. From what time can he swim?
is001.tt:
Midori Pool
Monday to Friday: morning 9:00-12:00, afternoon 1:00-8:00.
Saturdays and Sundays: morning 10:00-12:00, afternoon 1:00-5:00.
* Closed on Wednesdays.

is002.t: Anna wants to buy a boxed lunch and a drink for 500 yen. Which two does she buy?
is002.tt:
Boxed lunches and drinks
Fried chicken (karaage) bento: 450 yen
Seaweed (nori) bento: 350 yen
Fish bento: 400 yen
Drinks: tea 150 yen; juice 120 yen.

is003.e: After 2 on Sunday: 4:30 or 7:00. 4:30 + 2 h + 30 min = 7:00, so he's home in time. 5:00 is a weekday showing.
is003.t: On Sunday, John wants to see a movie that starts after 2 p.m. He wants to be home by 7 p.m. The movie is 2 hours long, and it takes 30 minutes to get home from the cinema. Which showing does he see?
is003.tt:
Sakura Cinema, "Song of the Sky"
Saturdays and Sundays: 1st showing 10:00, 2nd 12:30, 3rd 4:30, 4th 7:00.
Monday to Friday: 1st 11:00, 2nd 2:00, 3rd 5:00, 4th 8:00.

is004.t: Maria wants to join a Japanese class. She has a part-time job on Tuesdays and Thursdays. She prefers an evening class. Which class does she join?
is004.tt:
Japanese classes
A: Monday and Wednesday, morning 10:00-12:00.
B: Monday and Wednesday, evening 7:00-9:00.
C: Tuesday and Thursday, evening 7:00-9:00.
D: Saturday, afternoon 2:00-5:00.

is005.e: がくせいは がくせいしょうを みせて ください.
is005.t: Kim wants to borrow a book from the university library. What must students bring?
is005.tt:
How to use the library
· To borrow books, students must show their student ID card.
· Teachers must show their staff card.
· Books may be kept for two weeks.
· Please don't eat in the library.

is006.e: ④ is the cheapest but arrives at 16:00. Arriving before 11, the cheapest is ③.
is006.t: Tanaka is going from Tokyo to Osaka. He wants to arrive in Osaka by 11 a.m. Which is the cheapest?
is006.tt:
Tokyo → Osaka
① Shinkansen: departs 7:00, arrives 9:30, 14,000 yen.
② Shinkansen: departs 8:00, arrives 10:30, 14,000 yen.
③ Bus: departs 23:00 (the night before), arrives 7:00, 5,000 yen.
④ Bus: departs 8:00, arrives 16:00, 4,000 yen.

is007.t: Lin wants to play tennis in the park on the weekend. She prefers the morning. How much does she pay?
is007.tt:
Park tennis courts
Monday to Friday: morning (9:00-12:00) 1,000 yen; afternoon (1:00-5:00) 1,500 yen.
Saturdays and Sundays: morning 2,000 yen; afternoon 2,500 yen.

is008.e: Open on Saturday at 3: みなみ (until 5).
is008.t: Han has caught a cold. He wants to go to a hospital at 3 p.m. on Saturday. Which hospital does he go to?
is008.tt:
Nearby hospitals
Yamada Hospital: closed Sundays; 9:00-12:00.
Sakura Hospital: closed Saturdays and Sundays; 9:00-6:00.
Minami Hospital: closed Sundays; 9:00-5:00.
Hikari Hospital: closed Wednesdays; 9:00-1:00.

is009.t: Yamada is going to the zoo with her child (8 years old), just the two of them. How much does she pay in total?
is009.tt:
Himawari Zoo
Admission
Adults: 800 yen
Children (6 to 12 years): 300 yen
Up to 5 years: free

is010.e: No garbage is collected on Saturdays and Sundays.
is010.t: Nancy wants to put out her garbage on Sunday. What garbage can she put out?
is010.tt:
Garbage collection days
Monday and Thursday: burnable garbage.
Tuesday: bottles and cans.
Wednesday: paper.
Friday: plastics.
Saturdays and Sundays: please don't put out garbage.

is011.e: Open on Friday and for 5 people: C (A and D are closed on Fridays, B takes only 4).
is011.t: Ken wants to have dinner at a restaurant on Friday night with four friends (five people in total). Which restaurant does he choose?
is011.tt:
Restaurant guide
A Sakura: closed Fridays; up to 8 people; evenings until 10:00.
B Umi: closed Mondays; up to 4 people; until 9:00.
C Mori: closed Tuesdays; up to 6 people; until 10:00.
D Sora: closed Fridays; up to 10 people; until 9:00.

is012.e: Evenings from 6 and twice a week: ②.
is012.t: Emma wants a part-time job on weekday evenings from 6 p.m. She only wants to work twice a week. Which job is best?
is012.tt:
Part-time job listings
① Bakery: morning 6:00-9:00, twice a week.
② Restaurant: evening 6:00-10:00, twice a week.
③ Convenience store: evening 6:00-10:00, five times a week.
④ Bookstore: afternoon 1:00-5:00, twice a week.

is013.e: 3 kg → the "up to 5 kg" column; the fastest is airmail: 3,500.
is013.t: Sofia wants to send a package to her country from the post office. The package weighs 3 kg. How much does the fastest option cost?
is013.tt:
Sending packages (to your country)
Airmail: up to 2 kg, 2,000 yen; up to 5 kg, 3,500 yen; takes 5 days.
Sea mail: up to 2 kg, 800 yen; up to 5 kg, 1,500 yen; takes 60 days.

is014.e: 8:20 + 20 min = 8:40. The 8:50 bus would arrive at 9:10.
is014.t: On weekdays, Tom takes the bus from the station to his office. He wants to arrive in front of the office by 9 a.m. What is the latest bus he can take?
is014.tt:
Bus: Station → Office Front (20 minutes)
Departures from the station, Monday to Friday: 7:20, 7:50, 8:20, 8:50, 9:20.
Saturdays and Sundays: 7:30, 8:30, 9:30.

is015.e: Beginner level with a CD: B.
is015.t: Ali wants to buy a Japanese book. He wants a beginner-level book that comes with a CD. Which one does he buy?
is015.tt:
Japanese books
A: beginner, no CD, 1,200 yen.
B: beginner, with CD, 1,800 yen.
C: intermediate, with CD, 2,000 yen.
D: intermediate, no CD, 1,500 yen.

is016.t: Park is going to the art museum on Saturday. He is a university student. How much does he pay?
is016.tt:
Minato Art Museum
Hours: 10:00-18:00 (closed Mondays).
Adults: 1,000 yen on weekdays, 1,200 yen on Saturdays and Sundays.
University students: 700 yen on weekdays, 900 yen on Saturdays and Sundays.
High school students and younger: free.

is017.e: Sweets (ケーキ/クッキー) and the weekend: ③.
is017.t: Lisa wants to go to a cooking class. She works on weekdays, so she can only go on weekends. She wants to make sweets. Which one does she choose?
is017.tt:
Cooking classes
① Japanese cooking: Saturdays.
② Cakes: Wednesdays.
③ Cookies: Sundays.
④ Bread: Thursdays.

is018.e: Monday at 3 he has class; there's no Friday session; Wednesday 5 to 6 works.
is018.t: Mike wants to go to the library's Japanese café next week. On Mondays and Wednesdays he has school until 4. When can he go?
is018.tt:
Japanese Café
Let's talk in Japanese with Japanese people!
Monday: 3:00-4:00.
Wednesday: 5:00-6:00.
Friday: 2:00-3:00.
* There is no session next Friday.

is019.e: Within a 10-minute walk and up to 60,000: B.
is019.t: Jim is looking for an apartment. He wants one within a 10-minute walk of the station, with rent of up to 60,000 yen. Which one is best?
is019.tt:
Apartments
A: 5-minute walk from the station; rent 70,000 yen.
B: 8-minute walk; 55,000 yen.
C: 15-minute walk; 40,000 yen.
D: 10 minutes by bus; 35,000 yen.

is020.e: 7 years old and can't swim: イルカ.
is020.t: Yui wants to join a children's swimming class during the summer holidays. She is 7 and can't swim yet. Which class does she join?
is020.tt:
Children's swimming classes (July and August)
Penguin: ages 4 to 6; Mondays and Wednesdays.
Dolphin: ages 7 to 9, can't swim yet; Tuesdays and Thursdays.
Whale: ages 7 to 9, can swim; Tuesdays and Fridays.
Shark: ages 10 to 12; Saturdays.

is021.t: Maria wants to do yoga on a weekday evening. How much does she pay?
is021.tt:
Sports center
Yoga (morning): 800 yen on weekdays, 1,000 yen on weekends.
Yoga (evening): 1,000 yen on weekdays, 1,200 yen on weekends.
Pool: 500 yen on weekdays, 700 yen on weekends.

is022.t: Takeshi's group is two adults and one child. They all take the bus. How much is it in total?
is022.tt:
Bus fares (station → airport)
Adults: 1,200 yen.
Children: 600 yen.

is023.e: Open on Sunday at 2 p.m.: C (B closes at 1 p.m.).
is023.t: Han wants to go to a hair salon at 2 p.m. on Sunday. Which one is best?
is023.tt:
Nearby hair salons
A: closed Sundays; 10:00-19:00.
B: closed Mondays; 10:00-13:00.
C: closed Tuesdays; 11:00-20:00.
D: closed Sundays; 9:00-18:00.

is024.t: John wants to take the Japanese test. He is busy in July. By when must he apply?
is024.tt:
Japanese test
Test on July 5th: apply by May 31st.
Test on December 6th: apply by October 31st.

is025.t: Lisa wants to go to the "Japanese songs" class on Saturday. What time does it start?
is025.tt:
Community center classes
Japanese songs: Wednesdays, from 18:00.
Japanese songs: Saturdays, from 14:00.
Origami: Saturdays, from 10:00.
Cooking: Sundays, from 11:00.

is026.t: Ali wants to borrow 3 books and 2 DVDs from the library. Can he borrow them?
is026.tt:
Library rules
· You can borrow up to 5 books for 2 weeks.
· You can borrow only 1 DVD, for 1 week.

is027.t: Kate wants to eat a lunch set that costs less than 1,000 yen, at a restaurant less than a 5-minute walk from the station. Which one does she choose?
is027.tt:
Lunch sets
A: 3-minute walk from the station; 1,200 yen.
B: 4-minute walk; 800 yen.
C: 10-minute walk; 700 yen.
D: 8-minute walk; 900 yen.

is028.t: Park is watching a movie on Friday night. He is a student. How much does he pay?
is028.tt:
Cinema prices
Adults: regular 1,800 yen; Friday night 1,200 yen.
Students: regular 1,500 yen; Friday night 1,000 yen.

is029.e: Plastic bottles go out on Wednesday.
is029.t: Emma wants to put out her plastic bottles on Monday morning. What should she do?
is029.tt:
How to put out garbage
Burnable garbage: Mondays and Thursdays.
Plastic bottles: Wednesdays.
Cans and glass bottles: Fridays.
* Please put out garbage by 8 a.m.

is030.t: Sam is going to the aquarium alone (one adult) on Sunday. Can he enter at 4:30 p.m.?
is030.tt:
Sea Aquarium
Hours: 9:00-17:00 (last entry 16:00).
Closed: Tuesdays.
Adults: 2,000 yen. Children: 1,000 yen.
